# Web view and retained web sources

Current name: **Web view**; **website** is the preferred public template ID and **iframe** is a retained public alias sharing its schema and renderer. Supply 1–16 public HTTPS pages. Grid is the default; the top toolbar is removed. Explicit paged layouts use agent navigation. Each page can request a desktop or scaled mobile viewport. See [current behavior and limits](../README.md) and [public usage/schema links](https://kanvas.host/docs/iframe). Remote embedding restrictions are respected; container delivery is never proof of remote content. No proxy or cross-origin DOM access is added.

The documentation below describes retained legacy `web` views only. This template is not part of current public discovery or new public publication schemas.

## Retained legacy web views

Existing `web` records remain renderable but are not offered for new publications. Agent-supplied excerpts and snapshots are explicitly labeled as supplied, not fetched/verified by Kanvas. A screenshot is not a live page, iframe navigation is not proof of visible content, and remote framing restrictions remain authoritative. Current website/iframe behavior and its bounded refusal fallback are documented by the running schemas and [implemented rendering](../display/implemented-rendering.md).
